 Formula p (I/O wait) n=1 n=2 n=4 n=8
 If each process spends a fraction p of its time waiting for I/O, 50% 50.0% 75.0% 93.8% 99.6%

 Computed by code: 1 − pⁿ for each cell of the table.



 Check (steps)
